plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's feelings. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This person has a way of reminding you that your feelings deserve room to exist.

Their care can feel abundant. Their instinct is often to meet your emotions with generosity rather than judgment, encouragement rather than criticism. Around them it may feel easier to believe that what you are carrying does not have to be carried alone.

This person makes it easier to be yourself. Their response to your feelings is usually support, not judgment, so opening up feels safer than it does with most people. When life is hard, they remind you that you do not have to carry it alone. When life is good, they are genuinely happy for you. Around them, it is easier to trust your own feelings, ask for what you need, and believe that things can get better.

One thing to watch for is using comfort to avoid the truth. You may rush to make each other feel better instead of staying with what the feeling is trying to tell you.

Take the support. Face the problem anyway. This connection is strongest when the encouragement helps you deal with hard things instead of avoiding them.
